pageInstruction: Listen to your teacher. Do one part at a time.
sectionLead: Two short paper checks made from this unit's own worksheets. Give Check A before you teach the unit and Check B after it, and you can see what changed. Each part belongs to one lesson.
sectionHonest: This is a classroom check of this unit's lessons. It is not a standardized test, and its points are not a grade.
notCovered: Not in the check: {lessons}. The worksheets of these lessons do not break into single tasks.
formsNote: Printing a check counts as a download, like any worksheet.
teacherPages: Teacher pages: points, class record, and what to do next
teacherNote: The answer keys and the teacher pages come with the paid {plan} plan.
tpHow1: Give Check A before you start the unit and Check B when you finish it. Both checks ask the same kinds of tasks with different numbers and pictures.
tpHow2: Read each direction aloud, one part at a time. The check is about the math, not about reading the directions.
tpHow3: Give one point for each task that is completely right. A task is one numbered box.
tpHonest: This is a classroom check of this unit's lessons. It is not a standardized test. The points show you where to look again; they are not a grade, and they say nothing about a child beyond these tasks.
tpGridLead: Write each child's points for every part, Check A on the left and Check B on the right. A part where Check B is not higher than Check A is a part to look at again.
tpNextLead: For each part, start from the lesson it belongs to. Every page named here is on the unit's page.
tpStillEasier: Teach Lesson {n} again. Then give the easier version of “{title}”.
tpEasyOn: Go on to the next lesson.
